question: What exact finite-volume observables control the response of the undirected h=0 sector ensemble to an infinitesimal uniform link field at fixed total jump probability p?
claim_boundary: This is an exact response identity and an existing-size algebra check. It does not establish differentiability after L tends to infinity, field relevance, a universality class, or a threshold.

frozen_model.geometry: canonical square with measured signed interior charges and unmeasured rough-boundary charges
frozen_model.field_path: w_h(0)=1-p and w_h(plus/minus 1)=p exp(plus/minus h)/(2 cosh h), so p is fixed
frozen_model.field_pattern: uniform scalar h in the canonical stored-edge coordinates; reference reversal requires simultaneous field-pattern reversal
frozen_model.verification: exact rational h=0 moments on the already used L=3 control at p=3/10 and p=1/2

registered_identities.tilt: Z_a(Q;h)=Z_a(Q;0) E_{0|Q,a}[exp(h J-N log cosh h)], with J=sum_e j_e and N=sum_e |j_e|.
registered_identities.gap_slope: partial_h log[Z_0/Z_1] at zero equals E_0[J|Q]-E_1[J|Q].
registered_identities.gap_curvature: partial_h^2 log[Z_0/Z_1] at zero equals Var_0(J|Q)-Var_1(J|Q)-E_0[N|Q]+E_1[N|Q].
registered_identities.risk_cusp: For D_Q=Z_0-Z_1, R(h)=(1-sum_Q |D_Q(h)|)/2 and -R'(0+)=sum_{Q:D_Q(0)=0}|D'_Q(0)|/2; non-tied linear terms cancel under Q to -Q.

competing_outcomes.linear_cusp: Some tied zero-field records have unequal sector current moments, so an infinitesimal field changes Bayes risk at order |h|.
competing_outcomes.quadratic_onset: Every tied record has equal sector current moment, so the finite-volume Bayes response begins at order h^2 or higher.
competing_outcomes.recordwise_only: Recordwise gap slopes are nonzero but cancel globally outside ties, leaving the risk onset governed by tied records.

acceptance.theorem: Derive the fixed-p tilt, gap derivatives and one-sided Bayes-risk derivative without discarding charge or boundary factors.
acceptance.verification: Exact L3 rational sums satisfy normalization, reflection cancellation and the registered cusp identity at both p controls.
acceptance.stop: Stop after the identities and L3 replay. Do not add a system size, fit scaling or label the perturbation relevant/irrelevant.

outcome: The fixed-p field is an exact exponential tilt by signed current J and activity N. Finite-volume Bayes risk can have an even |h| cusp: on the existing L3 control its exact right-slope magnitudes are 151263/1000000 at p=3/10 and 3/64 at p=1/2. Thus symmetry does not imply quadratic response; thermodynamic field relevance requires size-uniform control of the sector-conditioned joint J,N cumulants and tied-record cusp mass.
